}}'''Nerim''' is a [[Cairhien]]in manservant in the service of [[Talmanes Delovinde]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Nerim}}

== Appearance ==
He is very short and skinny with gray hair cut short of his shoulders. He had a long narrow face and was clean-shaven. He has a very pessimistic attitude.

== Activities ==
He sews Talmanes wounds after the [[Aiel]] assassination attempt on [[Matrim Cauthon]], and then is sent over to sew Mat's as well. Mat and Talmanes agree that Nerim makes a ham-fisted sewer.

When Mat leaves for [[Ebou Dar]], Talmanes sends Nerim as well, to carry on serving Mat.
He then stays in the [[Tarasin Palace]] with Mat and begins to transfer his clothes and all his money back into the [[Wandering Woman]]. Mat sends Nerim and [[Lopin]] to collect all the stored money and meet him outside the city when Mat carries out his plan of escaping with the captive [[Aes Sedai]]. Nerim and Lopin were competitive in fulfilling their duties to Mat.

He then catches up with Mat and then travels in [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show]] as cover for their escape. He is happy to finally be reunited with Talmanes.
